description:
A trilogy of beautiful, dangerous, and cruel truth between adolescent girls...

(Source: Manga Club)

Mail addressed to the previous resident, Shinoda Haruki, frequently arrives in the room where Tasaki moved due to a transfer.  Haruki got in touch and apologized for the leftover items. Before leaving, Haruki begs Tasaki to let him rent a room since he has nowhere​ else to go.  Tasaki decides to let Haruki stay for a limited time, even after finding out Haruki is gay.
A short story about a girl chasing after someone she holds dear.

Yogurt is an Alpha, and Cookie is an Omega who just moved to be Yogurt’s neighbor. Out of curiosity, Cookie wanted to find his brother, and was harassed by other Alphas on the street. Luckily Yogurt arrived in time and helped him, which, as a result, made them closer. What will happen next between them?

(Source: WebComics)

Yagami Touma became a delinquent after distancing himself from his childhood friend, Fuyu Atsushi, who wants to reconnect with him. The reason is something Touma could never reveal, he's actually in love with Atsushi. He ends up confessing on a whim, but Atsushi's answer is...?

title_romaji: Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko
description:
1-2. Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu no Neko:

In Gensei, where the ghosts reside, a beautiful bartender and his partner, a black cat named Gin, operate a bar. Amongst those visiting the bar was Natsu (a mythical twin-tailed cat), who makes a living reporting gossip. Despite this, he lives a life in poverty.
One day, he meets a widely popular pornographer, Hyde (Tsuchigumo). While hoping to do a scoop exposing Hyde's mysterious private life, Natsu sneaks in as a housekeeper. However, where he thought he would find a story, he instead finds his own body exposed through punishment with catnip and adult toys――?

3. Kochira ga Shin Sekai no Iriguchi desu
4-5. Yoiyami to Kuroneko to Boku no Kishi
6. Watashi no Shin Sekai e Youkoso
A young man moves to a college town where everything is not quite as it seems. A mysterious and very beautiful woman takes an interest in him, but what is the price of her beauty?

Straightforward Yamada Hirono falls in love with Ogata who gives his all for baseball. As her number of unsuccessful confessions climbs to the double digits his wish for her to leave him in peace to pursue his sport finally seems to get through to her. Will she really stay away, though, or will she be there to push his back when things get tough? A romantic comedy between a spunky, strong girl and a rigid but dedicated guy—

Included one-shot: Kiyoharu (キヨハル)

After the sudden death of his debt-ridden father, Kumi’s past life as a high schooler ends forever. His future as a porn star begins when the yakuza throws Kumi into the care of Sakuma, a trainer of adult video talent. While Sakuma teaches Kumi the art of sex, Kumi can’t separate the feeling of love with sex.
Flash forward years later. Kumi and Sakuma live together, work together, and sometimes even platonically share the same bed. They also found their own adult video production company called Lucky Hole.
But, Kumi is never sure how Sakuma feels about him, especially when they both sleep around and never with each other. With their lives so intertwined and unraveled, what is their relationship?

Shinjuku Lucky Hole depicts a series of adult love stories spanning over a dozen years of drama, heartbreak, and yearning.

(Source: Futekiya)

title_romaji: Ore ga Heroine wo Tasukesugite Sekai ga Little Mokushiroku!?
description:
Rekka Namidare was a normal boy until his sixteenth birthday. Then a girl suddenly appears from his future, warning him that he'll somehow start an interstellar war! It turns out Rekka hails from a special bloodline that's destined to get caught up in all kinds of trouble. Whenever a story's heroine is in dire need, Rekka will be given one last chance to save her. And in the future, Rekka will have saved so many girls that their jealous love for him will cause the apocalypse!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
A demon with a riceball-shaped head named Taizo comes to Earth looking for legendary girls with star-shaped nipples.

Contains 4 stories:

- Love Stalking: Mizuki's life's a mess. She has an obsessive stalker who's been leaving her creepy messages in her mail box, and her boyfriend dumps her because he got sick and tired of being harassed by her relentless stalker. Just when she decides to move out of her apartment, Natsume, a good-looking guy who reminds her of her ex moves in next door. Can he protect her from her stalker? And what's this about him being in love with her friend?! Contains the one-shots:
- Jumping To The Wrong Conclusions
- End Of Summer
- Doing the 180

For normal people, about one unfortunate event occurs in a 1 day period. But for some reason, it's different for Rinko. Unfortunate things seem to pile up one after another. All Rinko wishes for is to find some happiness in her life. With the upcoming New Year's celebration and a date with her best friend, Tatsuyuki, will her hopes and dreams be fulfilled?

Shana Ou Yoshitsune is an alternative story to the popular historical figure Minamoto no Yoshitsune along with his servants, including the renown Benkei who lived in the Heian Era. In this version, Yoshitsune was actually a weak, sickly boy who met an exact body replica in Hyouta, a traveling orphan who earn his living on the street. Being physically stronger, Hyouta was led to become a replacement for Yoshitsune, eventually claiming the name as his own.

Note: Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Shounen in 2004.

title_romaji: Me de Shireru Yoru no Junjou
description:
In Yoshiwara (present-day Tokyo during the Edo Period), the laws against prostitution were abolished and brothels were restored in the red light district. We meet Kichou and his "princess" who are the top courtesans of the Men's Brothel Quarters at Hanafurirou...

Series composed of:
Volume 1: Toku Hen (禿偏)
Volume 2: Keisei Hen (傾城編)
Volume 3: Hanazono Hen (華園編)

title_romaji: Wo! Shishang Zui Qiang Jin Zhou Shi
description:
Ye Lin is transported to a world overrun by demons. On the day of his class advancement, he becomes an SSS-rank Forbidden Spell Mage—only to be met with laughter and ridicule. Why? Because casting forbidden spells consumes the user's own life force. It's the most powerful class, but also a guaranteed death sentence. What they don't know is Ye Lin's secret: he's immortal. The class's fatal flaw means absolutely nothing to him. When they witness Ye Lin casually spamming hundreds of forbidden spells at once, everyone completely loses their minds.

"Just how many lives do you HAVE?!"

"Are you seriously using ultimate-level spells as your basic attack?!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Nagi Kuroki, a high schooler grappling with loneliness. Lately, something feels off. Memories they shouldn't possess, emotions they shouldn't experience. Strange memories flooding their mind. Are they human, or "Creators"? Within these memories, a girl's laughter triggers a sudden awakening of 'power.' What lies at the heart of this peculiar 'emotion'?

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

Laehwa Lee lost all her childhood memories after a terrible incident, and now that she’s an adult, she’s on a mission to recover them. But some people, like her rich and powerful stepfather, will stop at nothing to keep Laehwa under control. Out of options, Laehwa hires mercenary Itae Gwon to enter into a contract marriage with her. Though Itae is her shield, he also has an intense bloodlust. Will Laehwa be able to keep her cool as sparks begin to fly?

(Source: Tapas)

Kiyo is a brilliant junior high student whose inflated ego (and tendency to blow the grading curve) has made him a major target for teasing at school. So his father sends him a bizarre birthday present – a strange little boy named Zatch Bell – to help him make friends and reform his bad attitude. Zatch brings with him a mysterious red volume of spells, and Kiyo discovers that Zatch has magic powers that are unleashed by reading from the book! But there are more surprises to come, and Kiyo's destiny is about to change forever!

(Source: Viz Media)

Note: The chapter count includes the bonus chapter “The Two Queens”, as well as 16 “Gash Café” chapters.

An ordinary woman is reading her favorite novel on her way home when she gets into an accident. As she loses consciousness, she hears a voice say, “my name is Elsia Artize. Please save him for me!” When she awakens, she finds she’s become Elsia herself! Destined to die early, the new Elisa knows the only way to escape death is to save her crush, Prince Ixion, from assassination. Though she succeeds and is now ready to live her own life, the prince complicates things when he proposes marriage!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The moment his heart stops beating, Ye Zhongming goes back to the afternoon ten years ago when the catastrophe began.
Is God showing mercy to him? Or is it another punishment for him? Does he really have to experience the terrible end of the world again?
Ye Zhongming decides to fight to survive, not for anything else, but for his comrades who fought with him and the love who never abandoned him!
What’s more, he wants to find the answers. Why did countless roulettes fall from the sky for no reason? Who turned this beautiful blue planet into a ruin filled with broken bodies and blood?!

(Source: Webnovel)

Shuji, who stops at a local convenience store, encounters a neglected Rio, who shoplifts to get by. He then declares that she can come home at any time!
One day, when Shuji, who had been away from home on a sudden business trip, returned, he saw Rio trembling in the cold in front of the door...!

(Source: GOT, Translated)

Note: Published in Comic Anthurium Vol. 94

This is the serialized story between Nagai-kun and Hinohara-sensei, the most popular duo in 14-sai no Koi, about how they became a couple despite their age difference. It is full of dazzling and lovely portrayals of their wavering feelings (mainly Hinohara-sensei).

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes 5 intermissions and 1 extra chapter.

title_romaji: Hei Lian Hua Gong Lüe Shou Ce [Chuan Shu]
description:
I just had to be a keyboard warrior…! I read a sucky novel and wrote a scathing online review only to then find myself in the body of the story’s most despicable side character, the third female lead. Not only do I need to destroy the relationship between the main pair, but I’m on a mission to charm this bad-boy demon hunter, known as “The Black Lotus,” to complete my quest. We couldn’t be more different, but I’ll use every tactic I can to claim his love. I’m the one with the book in my hands after all, so this should be easy… right?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes nine extras chapters.

title_romaji: Hazukashigariya no Tsuma to Shinkon Seikatsu Hajimemashita
description:
I used to just buy food at the convenience store on the way home, come home, eat, take a bath, and go to bed....... but now it's different.
I have a lovely wife - but she's acting very distant!?

A shy little (?) comedy about newlywed life, with the cutest wife ever.

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

Seven years since the rare solar eclipse occurred, Adashino continues to assist those in medical need. After visiting a patient at a beachside home, the tactful doctor notices a shadow resembling a bird. This spontaneous sighting leads Adashino to reminisce about a story Ginko once told him about a Mushi that assumes the same form. Such a revelation, however, may lead to false optimism.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

In Japan, a mysterious and bizarre disease called "dissociative true feelings" has become epidemic among adolescents. The disease is not particularly life-threatening, but when one becomes excited, an alter ego will appear to express one's true feelings without any pretense. Sayoi's twin sister, Satsuki, a second-year high school girl, developed the syndrome after an incident in junior high, which also caused her to lose her voice. Since then, Sayoi has strictly avoided contact with the opposite sex in order to protect her sister, who can no longer speak with anything other than her true feelings. One day, however, she meets a boy, Shougo, who also suffers from the same disease, and the relationship between the sisters begins to change...?

(Source: Comico, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Yuna is serious and reliable, what will happen when she meets the mature yet slightly airheaded Biyori...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

For the sake of her family, she became his wife. But right after they got married, he told her “I made you my wife, but I will never give you my heart.” A few years later, she returned with a demeanor cold as ice, and she brought along a young child that looked just like him, which got his heart all flustered. Will his new feelings fluster her, too?

(Source: Dongmanshe, translated)

After a long carrier and satisfyine life, Chiba Tetsuya only desires tranquility and peace. Through flash-back scenes, the 1939-born author remembers the big moments in his life, his youth under the U.S. bombings, the exile from Tôkyô, his recklessness in those times, but also his carrier, his beginnings, the hard moments, Tezuka's death... an extraordinary life tale filled with a refreshing positivism. A rare testimony by a master storyteller.

This is the sequel to the popular Kindaichi Case Files franchise, set 20 years after the original version! Hajime is no longer a student detective, but is a poor office worker who has to deal with the daily pains of adulthood. No longer wanting to solve cases anymore, he keeps his head down and tries to go about his daily work as quietly as possible.

But crime never takes a break, and it isn't long before Kindaichi gets dragged into cases that occur around him. Starting off the new series, we revisit Uta Island, for the fourth edition of the Opera House Murder Case, where the Phantom of the Opera is planning a bloody revenge.

"I'm the only one who gets to see you so filthy, when you're usually so serious." Danno realizes he's gay in junior high school and professes his love to his crush, but is deeply hurt by rejection. Still disgusted by himself in his second year of high school, he ends up falling for another guy that spring. He tries to keep from being found out and to stop his feelings from developing any further by pushing away the object of his affections, first-year student Tsukasa. One day, Tsukasa finds Danno jerking off in the nurse's office. "Does it turn you on? Being watched by your crush?" Tsukasa's torturing and teasing make Danno dizzy with pleasure, robbing him of coherent thought!

The sweet discipline of a naughty, submissive second-year, who gets broken in by a mean, crafty, and younger straight boy.

(Source: Renta!)

Yuzuru, a yankee with a mean face, requests Satomi, his senpai, to "make him his little brother" in order to repay him for helping his family when they had money issues. Yuzuru then starts to follow Satomi around and serve him by tending to his every need. But Satomi is getting annoyed by all the attention, and our Yuzuru won't give up! Until Satomi decides to ask him to sleep with him...

Ever since he was a child, Maeda Taiki looked plain and shabby, and has never been popular. For these reasons, he wanted to at least have a good sense of fashion as an adult. So before he knew it, he became a shop attendant at a fashion mall. He has now found someone that he likes…. an employee at the fashion mall's main department, Yagii Haruhisa. Not only is Yagii kind and handsome, he's friendly with everyone he meets. He's someone that Maeda simply can't help but admire. However, Maeda is aware that he doesn't stand a chance of loving someone like Yagii… That is, until an awkward question from Maeda causes Yagii to steal his first kiss?!

title_romaji: Yoru to Asa no Uta dj - Aru Otoko no Higeki

description: A one-shot story based on the Elephant Man and Jack the Ripper.

title_romaji: Shitauke Tantei Nokori Kasuhiro: Misshitsu no Ryuugakusei
description: This man has solved cases even the great western detectives gave up on. This time, he faces a strange murder in a room from which no one can enter or leave...
Hyakko is a slapstick comedy which follows the lives of four high school girls as they get into various hijinx.

Enter Shizukuishi, a pants-wetting girl that literally fell into the lap of a boy named Kouki while he was visiting a robot maid exposition with his love interest and apparently his sister as well, Kaoruko. Things start rolling the wrong direction after Kouki ends up licking Shizukuishi's urine (don't ask)! A thread of light appears from a mark on Kouki's right hand and connects to Shizukuishi. Kouki is seemingly able to control Shizukuishi's actions through the thread. But wait, Shizukuishi has a seal for an ancient destructive giant within her womb that causes her to become "strange" at times. Oh yeah, and nobody can have sex with Shizukuishi, or else the seal on the giant within her will be broken.

Thus begins the strange story and juicy love comedy that is Iinari! Aibration.

Airi (a talented actress), Ritsuko (a weapons fanatic), and Junpei (a martial arts expert) - find themselves stranded along with Airi's fully functional T-74 military tank. Their only hope of getting back to Japan lies with the hot-tempered Elf leader Celcia's "restoration spell." During the ritual to translate the restoration spell into modern language, transfer and imprint it onto Celcia's body, the spell breaks into fragments and is imprinted onto the skins of other elves. Airi, Ritsuko, Junpei and Celcia set off in search of the spell fragments.

(Source: ADV Manga)

The Repentance Before Death is a webnovel widely hated for its awful quality. This never kept Yul-jeong Kwon from loving the series...until the author decided to kill off her favorite character. Ready to fight for her fave, Yul-jeong borrowed a backhoe to wreck the writer’s house. Unfortunately, she met with an accident and, when she opened her eyes, found herself in the world of her favorite webnovel as Mitchelle Nephthys, one of its most notorious villains.

(Source: Tapas)

A life of kindness, and it all came to an end. If given another chance, will I live the same way?

(Source: Toomics)

A heartwarmingly cute yuri manga about a seamstress and a zombie girl. What if your friend became a zombie? What if you were in love with that friend?

Note: Volume includes two extra chapters.
Volume 6 of the Itou Junji Kessakushuu series.

After falling to her death at the hands of her stepsister, Shu Lan, Meng Ting wakes up in her second year of high school. In this life, all she wants is to help out her loving stepfather, fix her poor eyesight, and avoid Jiang Ren, the delinquent young prince of the country’s most prominent real estate company, who threw her previous life into chaos. But while Shu Lan is the one infatuated with Jiang Ren, it’s Meng Ting who seems to catch this bad boy’s attention...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Da-Young Kim happily donated her liver to her mother-in-law, but all she got was betrayal in return. Her husband’s whole family nefariously used and abused her, kicking her out before she even fully recovered from surgery. They went on with their lives, blissfully unaware that Da-Young swore revenge. She begins to systematically destroy their lives as they did hers, but what happens when someone unexpected gets in the way of her best-laid plans? In 1661, Yasui Santetsu is a member of the Yasui House of the Four Houses of Go. However, he's beginning to doubt that Go is his true calling. Outside of the Go house, he goes by the name Shibukawa Harumi, and he's fascinated by mathematical and astronomical problems. Specifically, Harumi is pouring all of his energy into creating a new Japanese calender.

The story is based on the actual astronomer and calender-reformer Shibukawa Harumi (1639-1715). In Harumi's time, the Japanese used the Chinese lunar-solar Xuan-ming calendar, which had not been updated in nearly 800 years. At that point, there was already a two-day delay in the winter solstice. He reformed the calendar based on his careful astronomical observations.
